title: Incredibly awkward to use
body:
It is very hard to add or edit workout data and this has been unaddressed for years! For example, it is unclear why you cannot add ‘exercise minutes’  but you can add ‘workout data’ until you lead that the former is a calculation based on other data, and the latter is the data itself. This is never clearly explained in the UI. 

Once you’re in ‘workout data’, for some reason you can find ‘Add Data’ tucked away in the right top corner (why Apple, don’t buttons look like buttons anymore?).
When you select it, you have to scroll through dozens of activity types until you find the one you want. Why doesn’t Apple sort by most used types first (“recommended types”), before it shows the list of other activities? 
It doesn’t do a best-guess calorie suggestion based on time and activity. This data can be easily calculated.
Then you have to use the most unfriendly from-to date/time picker ever; a gigantic wheel where you have to scroll through days, hours and minutes. 
Why don’t you let me just enter this data as text instead of the scroll-fest and why isn’t the “to” field a “duration” field instead so I can just enter 1 hour? Who works out for 3 days in one setting? 

Furthermore the same week, month, year view doesn’t allow me to tap on an existing workout ‘vertical bar’ to edit it.  No, for this I somehow need to scroll all the way down until I locate “Show All Dats” where I can delete existing data by swiping left *but cannot edit existing data* by selecting a row.*

This is just a single Health feature I loathe but generally speaking it is the lack of care that has plagued this app for years now.
It translates to the Apple Watch in general where it cannot even warn me on time that my workout is still going while I step in the car to drive back home; the Bluetooth car connection should be a clear indicator to suggest stopping the workout immediately. Similarly it could suggest to start the workout of my favorite type based on GPS location and time.
And even worse, it’s practically impossible to correct this data retroactively. It’s unclear where to do it, how to do it, and seemingly too much work to do it.

title: Medicijnen app verbeteringen
body:
Ik ben redelijk tevreden over het onderdeel medicijnen. Ik krijg keurig meldingen op de ingestelde tijd.

Een minpunt vind ik dat het niet mogelijk is om de ingestelde dosering aan te passen. Niet relevante instellingen kunnen wel aangepast worden, maar de dosering en naam (in geval van schrijffouten) niet.

Ik zou het ook handig vinden als er een directe link is tussen het medisch ID en de app. Nu moet je op twee plaatsen de medicijnen vastleggen.

Tot slot zou het koppelen van de wekker met app ook een welkome toevoeging zijn. Ik krijg nu de melding uit de app en stel zelf de wekker in.
